focus_areas: Structural integrity of the sign mounting (specifically the right-side connection)
Adherence to regulatory design standards (color, shape, typography)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the 'text_gibberish' artifact. The primary failure mode here is the inability of the generator to render coherent text, which immediately disqualifies it as a functional 'street sign' per the taxonomy. Additionally, investigate the physical connection point on the right; use the open_vocabulary_detector to locate the pole and sign, then pass these bounds to the topology auditor to check for fusion. Do not be misled by the general 'sign-like' silhouette; prioritize functional components (readable text) over gross geometry.
image_description: A low-angle shot of a stylized, arched street sign structure against a deep blue sky. The structure consists of a dark, curved top beam and a lower, horizontal rectangular panel. Both panels feature white lettering that appears distorted, mirrored, or nonsensical (gibberish), resembling AI-generated text artifacts. There are red graphical elements on the upper arch. The overall aesthetic is surreal and lacks the crisp, standardized typography of real-world signage.
